description: Surfaced during fz-gdf (2026-07-15): the agent observed that the 59 (now 56 post-fz-d1g) debug-matrix reds at a20f29ab3 are ALL diagnostics-golden mismatches -- stdout matches, but a type/no-matching-clause warning now lands on stderr where the fixture expects none. fz-d1g fixed the one fixture with a NON-EMPTY expected.diagnostics (tree); fixtures with NO golden that now emit the warning fail on unexpected stderr. HYPOTHESIS to verify: most of the historical known-red baseline (74 at eae19c725) was already this class (the fz-9i4 unification landed many fixtures whose fns are legitimately non-exhaustive), and the fz-1ah.2 span-rendering made it more visible. INVESTIGATE: classify all ~56 failing names by failure mode (diagnostics-only vs functional); then resolve the CLASS -- options: (a) the warning is correct and fixtures should declare expected.diagnostics (bless sweep with per-fixture review); (b) the fixtures should be exhaustive (add wildcard clauses -- changes fixture semantics, scrutinize); (c) harness policy: warnings-on-stderr compared only when a golden exists (weakens the gate -- scrutinize against no-silent-red). This directly feeds the fz-rh2.16.6 keystone coverage decision: if ~56 reds are one mechanical class, the true functional known-red count is near zero and the coverage question becomes answerable.

comments.text: fz-9i4 re-audit at 939fdacdf independently reproduced the 56-failure llvm-cov matrix count. The coverage report still measured 89.0762% lines and passes fail-under-lines 87, so coverage slack is separable and fz-9i4.7.8 can restore 87 now. The deferred enum_map_family native failures are not part of the diagnostics-only class; current minimized replacements are fz-9i4.7.10 (callable with_index mapper input omitted) and .7.11 (cross-call list element ABI contamination).

title: the remaining ~56 debug matrix reds may be ONE class: type/no-matching-clause warnings on stderr vs fixtures with no/empty diagnostics golden -- investigate and resolve the class
